title: Hacker News: Government Rails Site Hit Hours After CVE Patch
description: HN Score: 19 pts | Comments: 6 | Government Rails Site Hit Hours After CVE Patch

ko.title: 정부 Rails 사이트, CVE 패치 후 몇 시간 만에 해킹당해
ko.hook: CVE 취약점 패치가 적용되었음에도 정부 웹사이트가 여전히 공격받는 현실, 개발자들이 주목해야 할 이유
key_takeaways: CVE 취약점 관련 패치가 적용되었음에도 정부 Rails 사이트가 해킹당함
공격이 패치 직후 발생해 신속한 대응의 중요성 강조
개발자들은 패치 적용 후에도 지속적인 보안 모니터링 필요

en.title: Government Rails Site Hit Hours After CVE Patch
en.hook: A government Rails site was compromised just hours after a CVE patch, highlighting the urgency of post‑patch security monitoring.
key_takeaways: A government Rails site was compromised shortly after a CVE patch was applied.
The incident underscores the need for rapid security response and continuous monitoring.
Developers must verify patches and maintain vigilant security practices.

zh.title: 政府Rails网站CVE补丁后几小时即遭攻击
zh.hook: CVE漏洞补丁发布后几小时内，政府Rails网站即遭攻击，提醒开发者需重视补丁后的安全监控
key_takeaways: CVE漏洞补丁发布后，政府Rails网站仍遭攻击
攻击发生在补丁发布后几小时内，凸显了快速安全响应和持续监控的重要性
开发者需验证补丁并保持严格的安全实践
